transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… it’s my eating. After my shifts at the register, I’ll buy way too much takeout—burgers, fries, chicken, desserts, like enough for a whole family—and then I end up eating almost all of it by myself before I go home.
How often do you find yourself eating this large amount of food in one sitting?
Lately… for the last few months, it’s been maybe three or four nights most weeks. I don’t think there’s been a week since those foreclosure calls started where it didn’t happen at least once.
When you're eating all that food, do you feel like you can stop whenever you want?
No… not really. Once I take the first bite, it’s like something shuts off. I’ll be thinking, Demetrius, stop, you don’t need more, but… my hands just keep going to the next thing.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating all that food by yourself?
I mean… yeah, I guess sometimes. I don’t really like thinking about it after.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating when you have these episodes?
No… I don’t really feel in control. Once I take that first bite, it’s like something clicks off, and even if I’m telling myself to stop, my hands just keep reaching for more.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been keeping track. My clothes feel different sometimes, but I’m not sure how much.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes?
I’m not really sure. I don’t pay that much attention to the speed… I just kind of realize afterward that I ate a lot.
Are you usually stressed or upset before one of these eating episodes happens?
I don’t really know. Maybe sometimes, but I haven’t paid enough attention to say for sure.
Are you usually feeling emotionally upset before one of these eating episodes happens?
I’m not sure. I mean… sometimes I might be upset, but I don’t really think about it before it happens.
Do you feel like you're aware of what's going on around you while you're eating all that food?
I don’t really know. I’m usually just focused on eating, I guess… I haven’t really noticed what’s going on around me.
Do you think you eat this way when you're feeling upset or stressed?
I don’t know. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really connected it to being stressed or upset. It just kind of happens.
Do you ever find that you don't remember eating some of the food during one of these episodes?
I don’t really know… I haven’t paid attention to it like that. I don’t think I’ve noticed missing parts, exactly.
Do you always feel guilty after eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I’m not sure I’d say always. Sometimes I feel bad about it, yeah… but I don’t really keep track every time.
Do you feel guilty after every episode of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I don’t know if it’s every time. I mean… sometimes, yeah, I feel pretty bad after. But I can’t say I’ve really noticed it every single time.
Do you feel guilty after most of these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I don’t really know… probably sometimes, but “most” is hard for me to say. I don’t think I’ve kept track like that.
Do you feel guilty after almost all of these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?
I… I don’t know. “Almost all” sounds like a lot. I know it happens sometimes, but I can’t really say it’s that often.
Do you feel guilty after almost every time you eat a large amount of food by yourself?
I’m not really sure… I know I feel bad sometimes after, but “almost every time” feels hard to say. I haven’t really paid that close attention.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes more often than not?
I’m not sure. Maybe sometimes, but I don’t really know if it’s more than half. I haven’t been keeping track.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself more often than you don't?
I still don’t really know. I mean, sometimes I do feel guilty, yeah… but I can’t say if it’s more often than not. I don’t really keep count.
